[[PW0:001]]
【24小时速递】
[[PW0:002]]
生数科技把 Vidu S2 全量放出来了，发布当天网页就能试。S2-Avatar 做实时数字角色，画面提到 720P，对话中途还能塞参考图，让角色换衣服、换背景、拿指定物品；S2-Editing 对着摄像头或视频流，实时改风格、人物和场景。他们还试了左右眼空间视频，给头显看。技术报告挂在 arXiv（2609.11638），体验口在 https://t.co/03ZrWI2KJa 。
[[PW0:003]]
云知声发了 U2-Flash。稀疏 MoE，总参数约 266B，单次激活约 10B。港交所自愿公告和官宣里的数字：DeepSWE v1.1 拿 64.6，比自家上一代翻倍，也压过他们点名的 GLM-5.3-Flash 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813；SWE-Bench Pro 61.6，比前代高 10.5。Agent 任务迭代少 20%–30%，周期缩短约 35%，Token 消耗也少 20%–30%。限时六折是输入 6 元 / 百万 Tokens、输出 2 元；9 月 15 日到 30 日还能领 [[PQ0:001]] 试用，已经上了云知声 MaaS。
[[PW0:004]]
NVIDIA 把 OSMO 开源了，Apache-2.0。它不训练、也不仿真，只管把仿真、训练、真机评测写成一份 YAML，按硬件类型调度到不同集群；官方说内部给 Project GR00T、Isaac Lab / Sim / ROS 那一套跑过，每天扛过上千 GPU 小时。仓库里带了 agent skill，Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 可以用自然语言写工作流。你得有 Kubernetes 才能把控制面架起来，本地 quickstart 也写了不适合当生产环境。
[[PW0:005]]
Ao Qu 等人把 Reef 开源了。推理按兼容接口接进去后，轨迹和反馈会留下来；后台按配方异步更新模型权重，也可以改 harness（提示词、工具、编排），过评估门禁再热更新，不用停服务。仓库在 https://t.co/DlRrR9B1Qf ，Apache-2.0。
[[PW0:END]]

raw_text:
[[PW0:001]]
[24-Hour Express]
[[PW0:002]]
Shengshu Technology fully released Vidu S2, and the webpage was available for testing on the day it was announced. S2-Avatar handles real-time digital characters, with visuals upgraded to 720P, and you can insert reference images mid-conversation to change the character's outfit, background, or have them hold designated items; S2-Editing works against a camera or video stream to change style, people, and scenes in real time. They also tried left-right eye spatial video for head-mounted displays. The technical report is on arXiv (2609.11638), and the experience portal is at https://t.co/03ZrWI2KJa .
[[PW0:003]]
Yunzhisheng released U2-Flash. It's a sparse MoE with about 266B total parameters and about 10B activated per inference. Numbers from the HKEX voluntary announcement and official release: DeepSWE v1.1 scored 64.6, double their previous generation, and also beat the GLM-5.3-Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 they named; SWE-Bench Pro scored 61.6, up 10.5 from the previous generation. Agent tasks saw 20%–30% fewer iterations, about 35% shorter cycles, and 20%–30% less token consumption. The limited-time 40% discount is 6 yuan per million input tokens and 2 yuan per million output tokens; from September 15 to 30, you can also claim [[PQ0:001]] for trial, and it's already on Yunzhisheng MaaS.
[[PW0:004]]
NVIDIA open-sourced OSMO under Apache-2.0. It doesn't train or simulate; it just turns simulation, training, and real-machine evaluation into a YAML file and schedules them to different clusters based on hardware type. Officially, they've run it for Project GR00T, Isaac Lab / Sim / ROS, and the like, handling over a thousand GPU hours daily. The repo includes agent skills where Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex can write workflows in natural language. You need Kubernetes to set up the control plane, and the local quickstart is noted as unsuitable for production environments.
[[PW0:005]]
Ao Qu and others open-sourced Reef. Once integrated via a compatible interface for inference, trajectories and feedback are retained; the backend asynchronously updates model weights based on recipes, and you can also modify the harness (prompts, tools, orchestration), pass evaluation gates, then hot-update without stopping service. The repo is at https://t.co/DlRrR9B1Qf , Apache-2.0.
[[PW0:END]]
